# technitium_zone_permissions (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_zone_permissions` manages, without managing it, found by `zone`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_zone_permissions" "home" {
  zone = "home.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The zone. Changing it moves the resource to another zone.

### Read-Only

- `group_permissions` (Attributes Set) The rights of groups on the zone. The server always keeps `Administrators` and `DNS Administrators` with full rights, whatever is set: leave them out, or list them with full rights. Leaving it out keeps the server's. The server silently drops a group that does not exist, and apply fails: refer to the `technitium_group` resource, or add `depends_on`, so the group is created first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_permissions))
- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `user_permissions` (Attributes Set) The rights of individual users on the zone. An empty set removes them; leaving it out keeps the server's. The server silently drops a user that does not exist, and apply fails: refer to the `technitium_user` resource, or add `depends_on`, so the user is created first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--group_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_permissions`

Read-Only:

- `can_delete` (Boolean) May delete in the section.
- `can_modify` (Boolean) May change the section.
- `can_view` (Boolean) May view the section.
- `name` (String) The group name.
